responses.draft_cover_letter:
I’m excited about the Frontend Engineer role at Brightdesk because my recent work aligns closely with the core responsibilities you outlined. I built React and TypeScript dashboards for warehouse operators that serve 600 staff members daily, giving me more than three years of hands‑on experience with the exact stack you rely on.

Working side‑by‑side with product designers, I led usability tests and delivered WCAG AA accessibility fixes, ensuring the interface meets high accessibility standards. In the same projects I reduced p95 API latency from 900 ms to 180 ms, demonstrating a proven focus on performance optimization that directly improves user experience.

I also created a personal budgeting application with Next.js and Supabase, giving me practical exposure to server‑side rendering and modern React tooling. While I have not yet used Jest, Testing Library, Storybook, or formal design‑system libraries, I am eager to apply my testing mindset and quickly adopt those tools to maintain Brightdesk’s quality standards.

I look forward to contributing to Brightdesk’s helpdesk UI, collaborating closely with designers, and expanding my skill set in testing and design‑system implementation to help deliver a fast, accessible, and reliable product.
